o.text: Internationalism; via Russian фонология (fonologija). Ultimately from Ancient Greek φωνή (phōnḗ, “sound”) and -λογία (-logía).
From Persian حقه باز (“player at cups-and-balls; juggler; pick-pocket; plotter, impostor”), from Arabic حُقَّة (ḥuqqa, “cup of a juggler”). By surface analysis, hoqqa + -baz.
